title: Ship checklist — the target set before the pause
rule: An item is DONE only on live-verified evidence with a picture. Committed, pushed and wired all count as NOT DONE.

items.item: Clean engine serves; market-fitted family archived
items.done_test: served predictions carry the successor model tag, live

items.item: Win probabilities corrected — one value across every page
items.done_test: six pins at 12.5569 in one commit; two surfaces return the same number for the same game; coverage ~90.2
items.evidence: AUTO-HELD on its own gate 2026-08-11, closed with the reason and the number. Two of the three checks passed: after repointing, all four pins read one identical value, and the served probability reproduced twice - from the recorded measurement at 12.5569 on 1,474 games, and by recomputing every one of the 268 served rows from its own stored spread and centre with zero mismatches. THE FAILING NUMBER IS COVERAGE: 90.11 percent against a required 89 to 90, measured on 182 played regular-season games. It misses by eleven hundredths of a point and turns on a single game - 164 of 182 inside; 163 would have passed - and it errs wide, which is the safe direction. Nothing was tuned toward the bar: the spread is measured from residuals and the module states in its own header that the band is never widened to reach a coverage bar. The repoint was reverted, so the promote did not ship.

items.item: Front page rebuilt to the CEO's layout
items.done_test: status, queue and completed work visible at once; numbers small and at the bottom
items.evidence: CEO verdict on the live page: Style is good. Front page carries machine state, working-next and finished-today visible at once.

items.done_test: live, with movement and a note of when it was taken, fed by the accuracy feed
items.evidence: Live front page carries the Best Numbers panel small and at the foot of the page, matching the layout the CEO asked for. Verified on the public page and recorded as done alongside the front-page and totals-row items.

items.done_test: no null on any hero
items.evidence: Live front page renders the totals tile as not yet graded, the exact wording asked for, and no hero shows a null.

items.done_test: seven properties present on the live page
items.evidence: All seven house-style properties confirmed on a capture of the live teams page. The last one, sorting, went live this hour and reorders inside the tiers rather than dissolving them.

items.done_test: same
items.evidence: Cannot be built honestly, and the reason is bigger than this item. The players board would need a one-day move, but the served rating DOES NOT MOVE: measured league-wide over ten days containing many games, 368 players, zero changed, largest change 0.000 - and one player carries a single distinct value across all 110 dated rows. The date column is a label, not a time dimension. Differencing a constant would print a flat move on all 196 rows, which the movement standard explicitly forbids: an unknown move must never render as a flat one. Filed as its own priority item because every surface leading with this rating is showing a number that has not answered a game since 9 July.

items.done_test: same
items.evidence: Live standings shows a one-day playoff-odds move on all fifteen rows, each an honest dash because no new simulation has run since the comparison snapshot. Proven not inert: the same code returns real movement on eleven of fifteen teams when measured against a different simulation. A shipment card with a photograph of the live page was sent.

items.done_test: same
items.evidence: Live games board carries a move on ALL TWENTY-FOUR cards, re-measured on the live page after the restore - better than the twenty-one of twenty-four first recorded. A card that first appeared today shows a dash rather than a fabricated zero. Shipment card sent with a photograph of the live page.

items.item: Race-board standard applied to deep-dive hub
items.done_test: same
items.evidence: Live deep-dive hub reads as a board: twelve of the thirteen studies show how much data sits behind them, and the one without is the interactive tool, which has no fixed sample. Verified by rendering the live page rather than reading its payload - the content feed carries no such field, so a payload check would have said zero. Shipment card sent with a photograph.

items.done_test: live on teams; store has existed since 07-18, wiring only
items.evidence: Live teams page shows a one-day move column with real values on 11 of 15 teams, beside a two-week trend line. Confirmed on a capture of the live page.

items.done_test: oracle reproduced at regular-season grain, then annotation live
items.evidence: Red on correctly-grained bars, so it ships nothing, not even as an annotation. Measured on an identical set of games our 2023 comes out about six tenths of a point more accurate than the reference, and the base and environment halves want different anchors, so the suspect is the reference's own 2023 run rather than our arithmetic.

items.item: Standings feed onto the shared batch
items.done_test: its stamp matches its siblings on one bake
items.evidence: Live standings and playoff odds now agree on playoff odds for all fifteen teams, where the page used to disagree with itself on seven of them. Both halves come from one pass, one pinned simulation and one shared stamp. A shipment card with a photograph of the live page was sent.

items.item: Launcher --continue on every path incl. worktree copies
items.done_test: forced restart returns a session carrying its conversation
items.evidence: Both launch paths now resume by default instead of only when asked, and every one of the worktree copies carries the same change. Not done: the test is a forced restart coming back with its conversation intact, and no restart has been made to happen on purpose yet.

items.item: the width authorization file and its reader, checked every boot
items.done_test: same restart climbs back to 4 lanes unprompted
items.evidence: The authorisation now lives in a file the machine reads at every start, and all six cases behave: a missing or damaged file refuses loudly rather than quietly settling for one lane. Not done: the test is a restart climbing back to four lanes on its own, and that has not been watched happen.

items.done_test: per-worktree distance behind the current code reported; policy live
items.evidence: Both halves resolved 2026-08-12. The REPORT was delivered - all 120 copies measured and their distance behind reported, correcting the belief that five were stale. The REFUSE-TO-USE half now has NO TARGETS: measured tonight there are ZERO worktrees on disk, the reaper having cleaned every one, so a stale-copy guard today would be a check that can never fire. Recorded rather than built for that reason. NOTE FOR TOMORROW: agents begin per the external program and will recreate worktrees, so the guard becomes meaningful again the moment they do - build it against the first real copy rather than against an empty directory, where it cannot be proven to bite.

items.item: Acceptance bars recomputed at regular-season grain
items.done_test: gate re-run against correctly-grained bars — unblocks line A 1
items.evidence: The old bars were retired as mistakenly measured across two kinds of game, every bar was recomputed on regular-season games only, and the gate was re-run against them. It failed, honestly, which is the answer rather than the hoped-for unblock, and no band was widened to make it pass.

items.item: Admission gate reclaim ceiling cut from 1800 to 300 seconds
items.done_test: a hung holder costs 5 minutes, not 30
each wired or retired with a pointer
measured count of already-finished rows
inbox refuses a file duplicating a note already filed

items.item: the market grading feed carries a generated stamp
items.done_test: every feed stamped
items.evidence: The market surface stopped publishing figures and published an explanation instead, but the explanation carried no time of its own, so a reader could not tell whether the withholding was decided this morning or months ago and forgotten. It now carries its own clock, live-verified on the public URL. Wiring checked end to end rather than assumed: the site bake does NOT regenerate this file, so running its own baker was what proved the stamp reaches the served copy.

sections.title: Needs the CEO, sixty seconds each

items.done_test: the alert canary cannot self-check on his own channel without creating false alarms
items.evidence: The CEO handed over the spare channel and it is wired in. Proven the same minute: the daily self-check posted through the real message path and was then read back independently, so the alarm can now prove itself every day without ringing on the channel he actually reads.

items.done_test: token died in a crash; consumer degrades to an anonymous path, so nothing is broken today
items.evidence: Measured today: the account is logged in again and the token is live, so the consumer no longer falls back to an anonymous path. The CEO restored it himself.
